hero.title: Playtribe
hero.description: Playtribe makes it easier to find or create local sports events, meet people who match your energy, and turn showing up into a real community.

type_samples.label: Body (Plus Jakarta Sans)
type_samples.value: Join a game. Make it a habit.

tech_stack.title: Tech Stack
tech_stack.intro: A community-first product system designed around spontaneous plans, trusted participation, and low-friction connection.

cards.title: Mobile
cards.text: A warm, image-led mobile experience for browsing nearby sports, creating events, and managing your plans.

cards.title: Community
cards.text: Events are created by the community, with chat, friends, direct messages, and inclusive participation built into the flow.

cards.title: Trust layer
cards.text: Reliability scores, attendance confirmation, reporting, and ratings help people feel safer showing up with new players.

action.title: Inside the Action
action.intro: Explore the product flow from discovery to trust, participation, and community.
